name: Motion Design Showreel
tagline: Give it your logo and a few things to show off, get a short motion piece cut to the beat.
description: A 12–25 second show-off video for a product, a brand or your own motion skills. One shape from your brand, like the logo mark, stays on screen and does a new trick every bar: clicks, trails, colour floods, words that land on the beat, 3D type and grids, then it lands as your logo. It comes with a ready project that's already timed to the music.
bring: Your logo, brand colours and fonts
3–6 things to show off: features, values or skills
Optional: music you have the rights to
Optional: screenshots or screen recordings of the product
get: A 12–25 s 16:9 motion piece at 60 fps, timed to the music and ending on your logo
steps: Pick the shape that stays on screen and the things to show off
Plan one trick per bar on the music
Check the key frames in FrameJam
Build it on the beat in the included project
Review the video in FrameJam until it's right
